controls.name: BrowseButton
controls.label: Browse
controls.expectation: Opens a file picker filtered to .ppkg provisioning packages; selected path shown in ProvisioningPackagePathText.

controls.name: TransferButton
controls.label: Transfer
controls.expectation: Revealed only after a package is selected and an NFC/proximity peer is available; initiates NFC transfer.

controls.name: CancelTransferButton
controls.label: Cancel Transfer
controls.expectation: Revealed during an active transfer; cancels the publish.

notes: Transfer and Cancel Transfer are Visibility=Collapsed in the source XAML and are hardware/state gated (require a selected package plus an NFC proximity device). They are not expected to be present in an initial-state capture of either the UWP golden or the WinUI candidate.
